tools.add_blueprint_map_function_node:
Author one stock BlueprintMapLibrary Map_Clear, Map_Find, Map_Add, Map_Contains, Map_Remove, Map_Keys, Map_Values or Map_Length node for finite String-key/native Vector-value history or String-key/double-value preset workflows. Empty-default nodes retain their actual stock wildcard pins. Nonempty dedicated typed profiles additionally accept Key literals for find/add/contains/remove and Value literals for add, using only the existing String-double or String-Vector cohort. Such nodes receive explicit whole typed pins and stock Auto defaults before the public schema applies supplied values. Key/Value names are ASCII case-insensitive with duplicate aliases refused; partial values, empty Key and zero Value are supported. TargetMap stays wire-only and specialization_pending denotes the missing actual producer link, independently of the explicit unlinked type seed. Connect an exact own member Map getter or exact scoped own-function String/double local getter to TargetMap first using connect_blueprint_graph_pins; that separate operation must verify the stock callback specializes all map pins before later key/value wires. Typed literal values are retained through that separate current-source connection; construction alone does not prove connected specialization or runtime values. This does not execute a map, prove history values, compile or save. Map_Add overwrites an existing key; Find and Contains false, or Remove false when no key was removed, are normal runtime results rather than authoring failures. Contains is pure; Remove exposes execute/then and a bool result. Contains/Remove specialize Key without a Value pin. Keys/Values are impure, have no scalar Key/Value or bool result, and expose an output array of String keys or the selected native Vector/double values. Map_Length is pure, has only TargetMap/self inputs and an int ReturnValue, and accepts no Key/Value literals; its authored return pin is not an evaluated map size. TargetMap must specialize those array elements before output wiring; authored nodes do not prove runtime values or ordering. The same eight exact stock Map functions can also be authored through add_blueprint_call_function_node with explicit allow_wildcard=True and empty/null defaults; that path does not choose this dedicated tool's requested key/value profile. Other generic CustomThunk calls and Map types remain unsupported here. The separate original generic Call method below additionally admits the bounded exact Set route; this dedicated Map method is unchanged. Actual partial mutation/unknown states are retained without automatic replay or atomic rollback.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Exact admitted already-loaded runtime-safe Game Blueprint.
            operation: Exact clear/find/add/contains/remove/keys/values/length; each uses the existing String-Vector or String-double type profile.
            key_type: Must be string; no Name conversion or key normalization.
            value_type: Exact vector (native CoreUObject Vector) or double (PC_Real/PC_Double with no type object). The default remains vector.
            param_defaults_json: Bounded JSON object. Empty keeps the original wildcard path. Key is allowed for find/add/contains/remove and Value for add within the exact dedicated type profile; ASCII case aliases are accepted once and raw values/spelling are forwarded to Native conversion/schema validation. String keys and double/native Vector values keep the original bounded literal/number/bool/null/JSON fallback (Vector also accepts partial axes/arrays); finite double decoding is scoped to these key-bearing operations. TargetMap/output/unknown pins are refused. Generic allow_wildcard Map calls still require empty/null defaults. Actual raw/schema observations are reported; no runtime map operation is executed.
            node_position_json: Encoded JSON bounded integer pair; default origin.
            graph_name: Optional exact existing graph name.
            graph_id: Optional exact nonzero graph GUID agreeing with other selectors.
            graph_type: Optional existing graph kind selector.
            create_graph_if_missing: Must remain False; implicit graph creation is unsupported.
            operation_id: Optional durable request ID; unknown outcomes are never automatically replayed.
         Exact PresetLoader BFL Map nodes reuse the stock native Map lifecycle; no general BFL function or Map type admission is implied.
tools.add_blueprint_loop_node:
Add a stock ForLoop or a finite typed ForEach MacroInstance. ForEach admits native int/bool/name and exact object /Script/Engine.SkeletalMeshComponent with empty enum_type; Name and the component cohort extend the earlier native int/bool subset. The original tracker sent these ForEach descriptors through direct bridge commands, while the old public Python signature and resolver only exposed ForLoop; this extension does not establish that those original 5.6 recipes ran successfully. Retain the existing ForLoop keys/defaults and append an optional element descriptor for the additive ForEach behavior. Both source macro and target Blueprint must be loaded. Previous nodes, declarations, links, defaults and macro source are checked. This constructs one unlinked node; it does not wire, execute, compile or save a graph. Later Engine reconstruction can infer wildcard types from actual links; initial typed readback is separate from connected/saved/runtime proof. With create_graph_if_missing=True, Native first reuses a matching existing graph; if no graph matches, this finite route can create an exact-name own function graph only with graph_type=function and no explicit graph_id. Missing-graph creation admits stable ForLoop only and stays within the existing normal Blueprint/native Engine-Core parent profile; ForEach and Blueprint Function Library missing-graph creation remain incomplete. Existing admitted ForEach and finite PresetLoader BFL graphs may still be reused with True. Graph creation and node creation form one journaled operation; structural marking may regenerate the skeleton, and actual partial creation is retained if a later node stage fails. Breakable/while, broad element types, missing EventGraph creation and other graph-creation profiles remain incomplete. Partial/unknown outcomes are retained with no automatic retry or atomic rollback.

        A further finite ForEach descriptor uses element_type=struct, type_object=/Script/CoreUObject.AssetData and empty enum_type. This seeds the exact native AssetData array/element pins for AssetRegistry query results and GetAsset consumers; it does not admit other structs, automatically wire a producer/consumer, execute asset loads or complete PresetLoader. The stock macro, native structure/layout/current observations and actual partial mutation are retained. Connected and compiled type preservation requires separate representative evidence.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Exact runtime-safe /Game Blueprint path or simple name under /Game/Blueprints.
            loop_type: Defaults for_loop; ForLoop aliases for/forloop and additive ForEach aliases for_each/foreach/foreachloop are supported.
            first_index: ForLoop optional exact signed int32; null preserves its allocated native input default. ForEach requires null because it has no First/Last index inputs.
            last_index: ForLoop optional exact signed int32; no fractional truncation or bool conversion. ForEach requires null.
            node_position_json: JSON [x,y] bounded integer coordinates; JSON null means origin.
            graph_name: Optional exact existing event/function graph name; an exact new function name is used only by the create_if_missing route below.
            graph_id: Optional nonzero graph GUID agreeing with other selectors.
            graph_type: Optional selector; actual existing graph domain is checked.
            create_graph_if_missing: False by default. True reuses a matching existing graph first; a missing graph requires an exact graph_name, graph_type=function and no graph_id. Native owns name conflicts, context admission and actual graph/node partial outcomes.
            operation_id: Durable replay ID; identical request replays without duplicating the node.
            element_type: Required for typed ForEach: int/integer, bool/boolean, name or object with the exact component selector below. Omission/null is unchanged ForLoop admission; ForLoop rejects a supplied nonempty descriptor. The historical Python primitive pass-through is preserved; string remains unsupported by Native.
            type_object: For object ForEach, exact /Script/Engine.SkeletalMeshComponent only, with no aliases, asset SkeletalMesh or other object classes. Primitive ForEach requires empty/null. Array and Array Element are wire-only; no new array/object literal/default API is added.
            enum_type: Retained additive selector; must remain empty/null. Broader descriptors remain incomplete.
         Exact member-free PresetLoader BFL additionally admits only nonlatent ForEach with Name or exact AssetData element types through the existing stock macro writer. Other BFL functions and loop kinds remain unsupported. Construction is pending producer connection and does not prove loop/runtime execution or an AssetRegistry producer in BFL.
tools.add_blueprint_make_array_node:
Construct one native typed MakeArray node using the original eleven behavior keys/defaults. Registry list inputs are encoded JSON strings; the Python domain accepts typed lists, so full original reflected IO parity is not claimed. Native construction reports actual pin/default/graph changes and does not wire, compile, save or execute the array. The exact member-free PresetLoader Blueprint Function Library additionally admits Name MakeArray only; other BFL element types remain incomplete, while existing Normal Blueprint types are unchanged. Name values/input_count retain the existing conversion/default rules. Compile/save and runtime evidence are separate. Engine reconstruction may reset an unlinked wildcard node; connected/saved/runtime evidence is separate. Types include int/int64/float/double/bool/name/string/text, exact runtime Core Vector producers and byte enum/byteenum backed by an exact read-only /Game or /Engine UserDefinedEnum asset. Vector accepts finite literal arrays, lowercase axis objects, and schema-valid literal strings as element values; omitted/null values retain native defaults and supplied [] remains an empty array. The additional int64/integer64, float/single, double/real and Text elements keep the original bounded values/null/partial-list semantics and exact real subcategory. Exact int64 strings preserve their digits; JSON numbers retain the upstream binary64 boundary and native finite/range-checked truncation. These four primitive types and the additional descriptor route opt in to finite-double Registry/Batch values/element_defaults decoding; existing bounds for count/position and the earlier six types remain. Text raw DefaultValue can be empty while DefaultTextValue holds the value; requested/schema/raw/display observations remain distinct. Additional descriptor producers admit object/class, rotator/transform and struct/scriptstruct through a separate Native source/current/default path. Object/Class adapt the original public Python omission to the default Object constraint and preserve type_object path/name resolution; Rotator/Transform use implicit native Core types, while struct/scriptstruct require type_object. Python forwards bounded Any values without inventing object wire-only or saved-only admission. Native validates actual loaded/resolved source roles and public schema results. Exact full /Game object paths within the admitted source scope may use explicitly observed public SDK loading for a missing descriptor or Object/Class string default. Source before/after snapshots protect the held post-resolution baseline during node/default authoring; they do not prove that loading had no global effects. Actual load stages, loader/source refusal and retained partial allocation/default prefixes remain explicit. Unloaded short aliases, Engine paths and custom modules remain incomplete; existing already-loaded source admission is unchanged. Source admission, supplied non-null defaults and ordinary struct text must be read from the actual Native receipt rather than inferred from a descriptor label. Broader enum loaders and automatic graph creation remain incomplete. No runtime initialization proof, rollback or unknown mutation retry.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Exact admitted /Game Blueprint or original simple name.
            element_type: int/integer, int64/integer64, float/single, double/real, bool/boolean, name/string/text, vector or enum/byteenum; additional object/class, rotator/transform and struct/scriptstruct use Native checked source/type resolution.
            input_count: Optional exact integer0..128; overrides inferred values count. Both count and values omitted give one input. Zero creates an explicit empty array.
            values: Optional encoded JSON list string with exact int32, bool, or visible enum entry-name/integer elements, for example [2,4,6]. Name/string entries retain original conversion: strings unchanged, booleans true/false, numbers SanitizeFloat, null empty, objects/arrays common JSON serialization. Free-form spaces/empty/Unicode literals do not use variable identifier rules; native name storage has NAME_SIZE safety bound and bounded JSON still applies. Null/omission means no values. Supplied entries cannot exceed input_count; remaining pins retain native defaults. Int32 fractional truncation is explicitly rejected. Int64/real/Text values preserve original bounded literal/string/number/JSON fallback with native schema validation; numeric int64 truncation and binary64 precision are separate from exact int64 text. Text actual raw and FText defaults are reported separately. Vector elements accept finite numeric arrays (first three axes, missing axes zero), lowercase axis objects (missing axes zero), or schema-valid Vector literal strings. Wrong-type Vector axes and null/bool/scalar elements are refused. New descriptor values keep bounded Any input and partial-list semantics; Native owns the original math/string/object conversion, actual raw/Object/Text cells and checked schema application. A request string and a resolved default object path are distinct observations.
            type_object: Enum descriptor preferred over enum_type when nonempty. Struct/scriptstruct requires the original struct path/name; object/class forwards its class constraint. Original public Python filters an empty type_object out of its command payload, so the current empty transport adapts that public omission to Object. The original internal command explicitly given an empty string instead passed that string to its loader; this hidden eleven-argument wire cannot distinguish those presence cases, and internal explicit-empty parity remains incomplete. Rotator/Transform use implicit native types, independently of ignored descriptor text. Omission/null retains the original empty transport default. Existing primitive/Vector selector restrictions are unchanged.
            enum_type: Fallback enum asset path when type_object is empty; original omission/null remains empty. Source entries/metadata/disk are observed read-only.
            node_position: Original key, encoded JSON [x,y] bounded integer pair; null/omission means origin. The domain still accepts a list.
            graph_name: Omission/null adapts the original optional empty selector for an existing graph.
            graph_id: Omission/null adapts the original empty GUID selector agreeing with other selectors.
            graph_type: Omission/null adapts the original empty graph-kind selector.
            create_graph_if_missing: Must remain False; create a graph explicitly with its named tool.
            operation_id: Optional durable request ID; completed identical results replay without duplicate allocation.
            element_defaults: Additive exposure of the original internal command alias, encoded JSON list. Used only when values is absent/null; ignored when values is supplied.
